habits.boundary_condition: Treat walking distance as the reusable threshold; use a stricter walk-time limit only when the current request explicitly supplies one
habits.condition: When searching for a hotel in a coastal or beach-oriented area
habits.default_action: Prioritize properties on the beach or close enough to walk while also filtering to the trip's stated budget
habits.exception_condition: Do not apply this preference to non-coastal trips or when the current trip names a different location priority
habits.name: Prefer beach-proximate hotels
habits.preference_value: A hotel on or near the beach, ideally within walking distance
habits.rationale: Three independent hotel searches consistently request beach proximity alongside a budget, but they do not establish a reusable exact price ceiling or a willingness to exceed budget for location.

source_evidence.contribution: Directly supports prioritizing a beachfront or very short walking-distance location.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: I would like to stay in Naples, Florida at the beachfront, very close to the beach. Less than 5-minute walk is preferable.

source_evidence.contribution: Independently supports beach access within walking distance while retaining a trip-specific budget constraint.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: And we want to be on the beach or close to, within walking distance. I want it to be $300 or less per night. 4 stars on Google.

source_evidence.contribution: Independently supports beach proximity as a hotel-location preference in a search that later also specifies a price range.
